caption: The drawing depicts a tool with two vertical cylindrical handles made of wood, positioned on either end of a curved, horizontal metallic blade. The handles are colored in shades of grayish brown, showing wood grain texture, and are slightly wider at the bottom. The blade connects the tops of both handles and arches upward in the middle, with the cutting edge facing downward. The blade has a rusty brown color with metallic highlights, indicating a metal material with some oxidation. The tool is centered against a plain beige background with no additional objects or patterns.
title: Drawknife
